programs.name: sufbpickw
programs.purpose: Pick first breaks using the ratio of forward and backward amplitude windows.

params.name: keyg
params.description: Header word used to group traces into gathers.

params.name: window
params.description: Length in seconds of each forward and backward window; the selfdoc says 0.03.

params.name: test
params.description: When nonzero, replace trace samples with the characteristic function.

params.name: o
params.description: Offsets defining the pick template; required with t and must have the same number of values.

params.name: t
params.description: Times defining the pick template; when omitted, the whole trace is searched and o is ignored.

params.name: tdv
params.description: Half-length of the template search window in seconds; -1 selects nt samples. The selfdoc says 0.05.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Sliding absolute-amplitude sums accumulate float rounding error; interpolation, smoothing, division and rounding affect picks. The smoothing call and isamax search can access beyond the characteristic-function array for some window or template values, so behavior can depend on undefined memory accesses.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers gathers and combines interpolation, moving-window sums, smoothing and peak picking.

test_cases.description: Pick across the full trace and output the characteristic function.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sufbpickw window=0.016 test=1

test_cases.description: Use an offset-time template and retain the original samples.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sufbpickw keyg=ep window=0.016 t=0.08,0.12 o=0,1000 tdv=0.02 test=0

programs.name: sufnzero
programs.purpose: Print the times of the first and/or last samples exceeding a threshold for each trace.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUFNZERO - get Time of First Non-ZERO sample by trace

params.name: mode
params.description: Select first, last or both nonzero sample times.

params.name: min
params.description: A sample is selected when its absolute value is strictly greater than this threshold.

params.name: key
params.description: Header words printed before the selected times.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Times are computed using integer arithmetic in i*tr.dt/1000 before conversion to float, yielding integer milliseconds and potentially overflowing for sufficiently large values. Threshold comparisons and ASCII formatting depend on floating-point values.
programs.difficulty_reason: It scans each trace for threshold crossings and prints optional header values.

test_cases.description: Print the first nonzero time for each trace.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=4 dt=0.004 it=20 | sufnzero mode=first min=0

test_cases.description: Print both endpoints with trace headers and a nonzero threshold.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | sufnzero mode=both min=0.1 key=tracl,offset

test_cases.description: Exercise the last-sample mode on zero traces.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=64 ntr=3 | sufnzero mode=last min=0

programs.license_note: Credits Geocon's Garry Perratt and says it is based on surms, itself based on sugain and sumax.

programs.name: supickamp
programs.purpose: Resample a time window on each trace and output selected amplitude, time, energy or position picks.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPICKAMP - pick amplitudes within user defined and resampled window

params.name: d2
params.description: Lateral sampling interval; a nonzero value is required when key is absent, and key forces d2 to zero.

params.name: key
params.description: Header word supplying lateral position; required when d2 is absent or zero.

params.name: x_above
params.description: Lateral positions for the upper window boundary; must have the same number of values as t_above.

params.name: t_above
params.description: Times for the upper window boundary; must have the same number of values as x_above.

params.name: t_xabove
params.description: File containing time and lateral-position pairs for the upper boundary.

params.name: t_xbelow
params.description: File containing time and lateral-position pairs for the lower boundary; requires t_xabove.

params.name: wl
params.description: Window width; zero uses the trace end unless a lower-boundary file is supplied.

params.name: dt_resamp
params.default: computed: from first trace header dt when the supplied value is zero or omitted
params.description: Time sampling interval within the pick window.

params.name: tmin
params.description: Input trace start time; overridden by the first trace's nonzero delrt header.

params.name: x2beg
params.description: First lateral position when using d2.

params.name: format
params.description: Output format: ascii or binary; binary writes arg2 then arg1 as native floats.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Controls per-trace output to outpar: 1 is descriptive, 2 is tabular, and 0 omits per-trace information.

params.name: outpar
params.description: File receiving per-trace and global pick information.

params.name: arg1
params.description: First ASCII output value; choices are max, tmax, min, tmin, abs, tabs, energy, x2 and i2.

params.name: arg2
params.description: Second ASCII output value; accepts the same choices as arg1. The selfdoc says i2.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Sinc and linear interpolation, repeated float time increments, and ordered float energy accumulation affect results. ints8r is called with itime+1 although only itime time values were initialized, which can read uninitialized memory or exceed the allocated array. The two boundary files share nx, so differing lengths can also cause out-of-bounds access. Global maximum starts at FLT_MIN, producing an incorrect global maximum for all-nonpositive data.
programs.difficulty_reason: It interpolates window boundaries and trace samples while tracking per-trace and global picks.

test_cases.description: Pick maxima over full traces using a regular lateral interval.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | supickamp d2=25 x2beg=100 arg1=max arg2=i2 verbose=0 outpar=/dev/null format=ascii

test_cases.description: Use header positions, a vector-defined window and finer resampling.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 | supickamp key=offset x_above=0,1000 t_above=0.04,0.08 wl=0.04 dt_resamp=0.002 arg1=energy arg2=x2 verbose=2 outpar=/dev/null format=ascii

test_cases.description: Write binary pick pairs using a fixed-width window.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=4 dt=0.004 it=20 | supickamp d2=1 x_above=0,3 t_above=0.04,0.04 wl=0.08 arg1=tmax arg2=i2 verbose=0 outpar=/dev/null format=binary

programs.license_note: Credits MTU's David Forel for the verbose=2 option.
